name: claude-howto
description: A visual, example-driven guide to Claude Code — from basic concepts to advanced agents, with copy-paste templates that bring immediate value.
one_liner: A free, illustrated how-to manual that teaches you to use Claude Code properly — slash commands, hooks, agents, and all — with diagrams and copy-paste templates instead of dry documentation.
buyer: A developer or small team lead who just adopted Claude Code and wants a guided weekend crash course instead of piecing things together from scattered docs and forum posts.
business_use_cases: A dev team uses it as onboarding material so new hires get productive with Claude Code in a day instead of a week of trial and error.
A freelance 'AI coding coach' uses the guide's structure as a syllabus for paid 1:1 or small-group coaching sessions.
A training company licenses the structure (with permission) as the backbone of a paid corporate workshop on adopting AI coding tools.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid, live cohort-based course that goes beyond the free guide with office hours, code review, and a certificate.
Sell premium add-on template packs (industry-specific CLAUDE.md files, hook libraries) that extend the free guide's templates.

steal_this: Record a paid 2-hour live workshop that walks a team through this exact guide's modules, tailored to their own codebase instead of generic examples.
